items.title: 東元攜安達康參與新加坡Data Center World亮相MDC整合方案 攻東南亞AI基建商機
items.title_en: TECO Partners with Andakong to Showcase Integrated MDC Solutions at Singapore Data Center World, Targeting Southeast Asia AI Infrastructure Opportunities
paras: 東元(1504-TW)今(29)日指出，攜手子公司安達康科技參與新加坡Data Center World展會，展現資料中心電力系統與模組化(MDC)的一站式整合實力，並積極拓展東南亞AI基礎建設市場。
東元指出，此次展覽聚焦MDC的一站式建置能力，展出涵蓋IT、散熱、電力、發電機、EMS能源管理與控制系統的五大核心模組，並展現從需求分析、系統設計、工程規劃、設備製造、模組預製、系統整合、現場建置至測試交付的全流程服務能力。
東元以執行中的10MW模組化資料中心專案為例，呈現五大核心從整合設計、工廠預製到現場建置的實際應用。
東元指出，旗下MDC解決方案可依照客戶需求、建置條件及可靠度等級彈性配置，有效降低現場施工複雜度、縮短建置時程，並提升工程品質與能源使用效率，滿足CSP對快速部署及彈性擴充的需求。
另外，東元整合集團設備製造與系統整合資源，由旗下安達康(TECOBAR)展出裝甲式及模鑄式匯流排產品，透過高載流能力、模組化設計及快速部署等優勢，因應AI資料中心不同規模與配置需求。
東元進一步指出，為提升在地供應與快速交付效率，安達康今年在馬來西亞檳城啟用裝甲式匯流排新廠，規劃年產能達40萬米，產品也以此通過IEC與UL國際認證。
總經理高飛鳶表示，全球AI算力需求持續升溫，資料中心的建置速度與供電穩定性成為企業競爭關鍵。而東元深耕資料中心基礎建設，已累計承攬建置容量1GW，並整合機電、電力、工程與模組預製能力，協助國際客戶加速AI資料中心部署。
未來東元將以馬來西亞為東南亞資料中心工程及模組預製的重要基地，持續拓展新加坡、泰國、印尼、菲律賓等高成長市場。
paras_en: TECO (1504‑TW) said today (the 29th) that together with its subsidiary Andakong Technology it is taking part in Singapore’s Data Center World exhibition, demonstrating its one‑stop integration capabilities for data‑center power systems and modular data centers (MDC) while actively expanding into the Southeast Asian AI infrastructure market.

TECO noted that the exhibition focuses on the one‑stop build capability of MDC, displaying five core modules covering IT, cooling, power, generators, and EMS energy‑management and control systems, and showcasing its full‑process service from demand analysis, system design, engineering planning, equipment manufacturing, module prefabrication, system integration, on‑site construction to testing and hand‑over.

Using an ongoing 10 MW modular data‑center project as an example, TECO presented the practical application of the five core modules from integrated design and factory prefabrication to on‑site construction.

TECO said its MDC solution can be flexibly configured according to customer needs, build conditions and reliability levels, effectively reducing on‑site construction complexity, shortening build time, and improving project quality and energy‑use efficiency, meeting CSPs’ requirements for rapid deployment and flexible scaling.

In addition, TECO integrated its group’s equipment manufacturing and system‑integration resources, with its subsidiary Andakong (TECOBAR) exhibiting armored and molded‑busbar products that, thanks to high current‑carrying capacity, modular design and fast deployment, address the varied scale and configuration needs of AI data centers.

TECO further explained that to boost local supply and fast delivery, Andakong launched a new armored‑busbar plant in Penang, Malaysia this year, planning an annual capacity of 400,000 m and having obtained IEC and UL international certifications for its products.

General Manager Gao Feiyuan said global AI compute demand continues to rise, making data‑center build speed and power‑supply stability key competitive factors for enterprises. TECO, deeply rooted in data‑center infrastructure, has so far undertaken 1 GW of build capacity and integrates electromechanical, power, engineering and module‑prefabrication capabilities to help international customers accelerate AI data‑center deployments.

Looking ahead, TECO will use Malaysia as a key hub for Southeast Asian data‑center projects and module prefabrication, and will continue to expand into high‑growth markets such as Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia and the Philippines.

items.title: 「小台積」0052見證台灣科技黃金20年 報酬翻24倍、規模逾1600億元
items.title_en: "Little TSMC" 0052 Witnesses Taiwan's 20-Year Tech Golden Age, Returns Up 24‑Fold, Assets Over NT$1.6 trillion
paras: 臺灣首檔科技主題 ETF 富邦科技(0052-TW)迎來掛牌20周年，累積投資報酬率超過2,400%，隨著商品分割降門檻，資產規模一舉突破1,600億元。投資人關注 0052 股價已大漲24倍，未來能否續投？富邦投信指出，此波成長並非單純資金吹捧，而是由AI強勁的硬體需求與訂單能見度(上看至2028年)所支撐；加上台灣掌握全球逾七成先進製程，0052 完整涵蓋全台科技產業鏈，在供不應求的科技創新浪潮下，仍具備長線轉型與持續參與的投資價值。

證交所林修銘：台灣ETF市場亮眼 扮演亞太重要樞紐

證交所董事長林修銘於致詞時指出，富邦科技ETF於2006年上市，當時正值臺灣產業由傳統產業轉型至高科技發展的關鍵階段。作為台灣第一檔科技主題ETF，0052不僅掌握了轉型契機，也為投資人提供參與科技成長的管道。
林修銘表示，台灣ETF市場規模成長驚人，從2003年第一檔ETF問世，截至2026年8月底，市場已擁有350檔ETF，上市櫃總資產規模突破11兆元，日均成交值達864.2億元。過去十年間，全球ETF資產規模成長5.66倍，而台灣ETF規模則成長了34倍，躍升為亞太地區第三大ETF市場。證交所未來將持續扮演溝通橋樑，推動商品多元化並協助業者邁向國際，期望將0052等成功經驗推廣至全球市場。

報酬率翻24倍！「小台積」0052完整涵蓋台灣科技供應鏈

富邦投信董事長黃昭棠表示，0052對於台灣證券市場與富邦投信均具有極具代表性的特殊意義，它既是全台第一檔科技型ETF，也是富邦投信發行的首檔ETF旗艦產品。自2006年掛牌至今，0052陪伴投資人走過PC、智慧型手機、3G/4G/5G到電動車與AI等技術革新。
黃昭棠提到，2006年發行初期，台積電在0052中的權重約為20%，截至2026年8月底，台積電持有權重已達64%，因此市場常形象地稱其為「小台積」。0052追蹤的「臺灣科技電子指數」嚴選臺灣50與中型100指數中的72檔科技電子股，完整涵蓋整體科技供應鏈。自掛牌以來，0052累積投資報酬率超過2,400%，展現長線豐厚的資本利得成果。

分割降低門檻效益顯著 AI基礎建設推升未來成長動能

富邦科技(0052-TW)基金經理人洪珮甄進一步分享，去(2025)年0052進行股票分割後，投資門檻大幅降低，帶動資產規模從約245億元迅速攀升至目前超過1,600億元，成長超過5倍；受益人數亦快速突破45萬至將近50萬人，定期定額戶數超過7萬戶，近一年規模與人數均成長逾10倍，名列市場前茅。
展望未來，洪珮甄分析，全球AI需求已進入大規模推論與實質應用階段，主要的雲端服務提供業者(CSP)資本支出持續擴張，訂單能見度甚至已延伸至2028年。而台灣在先進製程掌握超過七成產能，且在IC設計、先進封裝、散熱與PCB等硬體鏈皆具備獨步全球的實力。0052不僅投資單一巨頭，更是布局全台灣科技產業鏈的極佳工具，未來將持續扮演全民參與科技成長脈動的最佳夥伴。
paras_en: Taiwan's first technology‑themed ETF, Fubon Technology (0052‑TW), celebrates its 20th anniversary on the exchange, having delivered a cumulative return of over 2,400%. After a stock split lowered the entry barrier, its asset base surged past NT$1.6 trillion. Investors note that the price of 0052 has risen 24‑times and wonder whether the rally can continue. Fubon Asset Management says the growth is not merely a money‑fuelled hype but is backed by strong AI‑related hardware demand and order visibility out to 2028. With Taiwan controlling more than 70% of the world’s advanced‑process capacity, 0052 fully covers the island’s tech supply chain, giving it long‑term transformation value amid a wave of scarce‑supply tech innovation.

Taiwan Stock Exchange Chairman Lin Hsiu‑Ming highlighted the brilliance of Taiwan’s ETF market, calling it a key hub in the Asia‑Pacific. He noted that the Fubon Technology ETF launched in 2006, coinciding with Taiwan’s shift from traditional industries to high‑tech development. As the island’s first tech‑themed ETF, 0052 captured that transition opportunity and gave investors a channel to participate in tech growth.

Lin said Taiwan’s ETF market has grown dramatically, from the first ETF in 2003 to 350 ETFs by the end of August 2026, with total listed‑company assets exceeding NT$11 trillion and daily turnover reaching NT$864.2 billion. Over the past decade, global ETF assets grew 5.66‑fold, while Taiwan’s ETF assets expanded 34‑fold, making it the third‑largest ETF market in the region. The exchange will keep acting as a bridge, promoting product diversification and helping issuers go global, hoping to replicate the success of 0052 worldwide.

The fund’s return has multiplied 24‑times! "Little TSMC" 0052 fully covers Taiwan’s tech supply chain. Fubon Asset Management Chairman Huang Chao‑Tang said 0052 holds special significance for both the Taiwanese market and the firm—it is the island’s first tech‑focused ETF and Fubon’s flagship ETF product. Since its 2006 debut, 0052 has ridden the waves of PC, smartphones, 3G/4G/5G, electric vehicles and AI innovations.

Huang noted that when the fund launched in 2006, TSMC accounted for about 20% of 0052’s holdings; by the end of August 2026, TSMC’s weight had risen to 64%, leading the market to nickname the ETF “Little TSMC.” 0052 tracks the Taiwan Technology Electronics Index, which selects 72 tech‑electronics stocks from the Taiwan 50 and Mid‑Cap 100 indices, covering the entire tech supply chain. Since listing, 0052 has delivered a cumulative return of over 2,400%, demonstrating strong long‑term capital gains.

Fund manager Hong Pei‑Jen of Fubon Technology (0052‑TW) added that after the 2025 stock split, the investment threshold fell sharply, propelling assets from about NT$245 billion to over NT$1.6 trillion—a more‑than‑5‑fold increase. Beneficiary numbers quickly rose from 450,000 to nearly 500,000, with regular‑savings accounts exceeding 70,000. In the past year, both assets and participants grew over ten‑fold, placing the fund among the market leaders.

Looking ahead, Hong analyses that global AI demand has entered a large‑scale inference and real‑world application phase, with cloud service providers expanding capex and order visibility extending to 2028. Taiwan controls over 70% of advanced‑process capacity and boasts world‑leading strengths in IC design, advanced packaging, thermal solutions and PCBs. 0052 not only invests in a single giant but also offers a comprehensive tool to capture the whole Taiwanese tech industry chain, positioning it as the best partner for broad public participation in tech growth.

paras_en: During the Mid‑Autumn holiday, U.S. stocks swung wildly. Taiwan’s market opened after the break and briefly turned positive, but trading volume froze unusually. Under the double squeeze of lingering margin financing and weak turnover, the divergence between volume and price has locked bulls and bears in a stalemate. Yet, as the market’s volume shrinks, smart money is quietly shifting toward the next wave of industries benefiting from upgrades and earnings‑call themes.
Post‑holiday volume contraction oscillation, the real key is the freeze of buying at higher prices

Affected by heightened U.S. market volatility during the Mid‑Autumn break, Taiwan’s market opened shaky today. The weighted index briefly turned positive intraday but closed down 392.64 points at 47,631.96, slipping below the 48,000 mark. Trading volume was only about NT$785 billion. The index decline isn’t the most noteworthy point; the real focus is volume. Sell pressure didn’t expand noticeably and was even lower than pre‑holiday levels, but buying interest at higher prices froze to a one‑month low. This indicates it’s not a full‑scale bear attack; both sides are pulling back. Especially since margin balances rose sharply before the holiday, the lack of accompanying momentum creates pressure on floating gains and trapped positions. As analyst Zhi‑Lin Chen says, while volume‑price divergence and unsettled capital persist, there’s no need to chase price aggressively—adopt a “watch more, act less” stance, keep cash and position flexibility.
No volume on the market doesn’t mean no opportunity; a contrarian strength highlights industry logic

The market’s momentum may be limited, but that doesn’t mean every stock lacks chance. The real focus remains industry trends. Demand for high‑end power supplies and high‑speed connections keeps heating up, driving Maolian‑KY (3665‑TW) to rally against the tide today, up NT$105 or 4.49%. When Maolian‑KY’s low‑volume consolidation earlier this week was spotted, analyst Chen had already positioned members. The price briefly retested the yearly moving average, but he didn’t change his view because of the wobble. He argues that a stock’s daily color isn’t decisive; the underlying logic of high‑end power, AI data centers, and high‑speed transmission remains unchanged. Short‑term moves may swing, but the true determinant of a wave’s longevity is industry structure. Maolian‑KY’s renewed volume‑driven strength gave patient builders tangible wave gains today.

Conversely, Jingyuan Electronics (2449‑TW) showed a clear pull‑back after a rapid prior surge. We had already led members to take profits at relatively high levels. Even the best industry can’t ignore price levels and capital inertia; buying high, selling low is simple in theory, but execution makes all the difference.

items.title: 金像電獲Amazon擲近16億元參與私募現增案 雙方合作更推進一步

同時，金像電繼2026年以來在台灣桃園、中國大陸蘇州及泰國擴廠後，今天由董事會通過新增資本支出79億元，將續用於在台灣購地、購買設備進行擴廠，金像電的產能持續緊張，法人估金像電在台灣持續買地擴廠案，最快在今年第四季將見到買地的動作浮出枱面。

paras_en: In July and August 2026, PCB manufacturer Golden Image Electronics (2368‑TW) broke the NT$100 billion revenue mark for consecutive months, reaching a new high. Today (Sept. 29) it announced a private placement of about 1,586 shares at NT$856 per share, raising roughly NT$15.89 billion. The most notable participant is Amazon (AMZN‑US), marking the first time the e‑commerce giant holds equity in Golden Image, symbolizing a closer partnership between the two companies.

Following its 2026 expansions in Taoyuan, Taiwan, Suzhou, China, and Thailand, Golden Image’s board today approved an additional NT$7.9 billion in capital expenditures for land acquisition and equipment purchases to further expand its Taiwanese facilities. The company’s capacity remains tight, and analysts estimate that the land‑buying and expansion project in Taiwan could become visible as early as the fourth quarter of this year.

Golden Image disclosed today that it is issuing a private placement of about 1,586 shares at NT$856 each, raising approximately NT$15.89 billion. The key participant is Amazon.com, Inc., which is acquiring equity in the PCB maker for the first time and is estimated to hold about 0.3% of Golden Image’s shares after the transaction.

In Q2 2026, Golden Image reported revenue of NT$242.79 billion, a record high, with a gross margin of 34.65% (down 0.16 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter, up 5.09 points year‑over‑year). Net profit after tax reached NT$4.783 billion, also a record, recouping nearly one full share of capital, up 37.31% quarter‑over‑quarter and 1.82 times year‑over‑year, translating to earnings per share of NT$9.27. For the first half of 2026, revenue was NT$435.92 billion, gross margin 34.72% (up 4.35 points year‑over‑year), and net profit after tax NT$8.267 billion, a 1.4‑fold increase year‑over‑year, with EPS of NT$16.14.

With higher shipment volumes and prices, the company’s July and August revenues each surpassed NT$100 billion, setting new records; August revenue peaked at NT$103.84 billion. Cumulative revenue for January‑August reached NT$640.59 billion. Analysts estimate that Golden Image, together with Jianding (3044‑TW), could join the ranks of KY (4958‑TW) and Unimicron (3037‑TW) as a PCB maker with annual revenue in the NT$1 trillion club.

items.title: AI泡沫或將「早於預期」破裂？《大賣空》貝瑞全面轉向看跌期權：轉折恐提前至明年夏季
paras: 《大賣空》原型貝瑞（Michael Burry）再次加速押注人工智慧（AI）泡沫可能破裂，且這次他認為市場轉折時間可能比原先預期更早。
貝瑞在週一（28日）發布的投資通訊中表示，他正「從根本上提前時間線」，並將原本對美光科技(MU-US) 、Nebius(YNDX-US) 、安碩半導體ETF(SOXX-US) 及Palantir(PLTR-US) 的放空部位，全面轉換為看跌期權。
其中，美光與Nebius的期權到期日設定在明年6月；Palantir與安碩半導體ETF則採用2027年9月到期的長天期看跌期權。
這代表貝瑞目前押注的AI交易轉折時間點，最快可能落在明年夏季。

貝瑞轉向看跌期權：押注AI泡沫更早破裂

貝瑞在Substack投資通訊中解釋，此次調整主要是因為他提前了對市場轉折時間的判斷，因此希望透過期權提高空頭部位的槓桿。
他指出，較短的時間線讓更高槓桿變得更容易接受，而看跌期權正適合這種布局。此外，受到VIX等波動率指標大幅收窄影響，目前期權價格相對便宜。
具體而言：

貝瑞將美光空頭部位換成6月到期、行使價約500美元的看跌期權；
Nebius則轉為6月到期、行使價為兩位數的看跌期權；
安碩半導體ETF的空頭部位則改為2027年9月到期、行使價略高於400美元的看跌期權；
Palantir則合併原有空頭與看跌期權部位，進一步集中至2027年9月到期、行使價略高於100美元的看跌期權。


貝瑞表示，截至目前，看跌期權已完全取代原本的空頭部位。
他也指出，部分調整與稅務虧損收割有關，但大多數調整則來自上週末進行的研究。這些研究使他更加相信，AI泡沫可能會比原先預期更早破裂。

AI資本支出仰賴未驗證營收假設

貝瑞此次加速看空的依據之一，是Ares Management發布的一份研究報告。
該報告指出，目前AI產業繁榮建立在「AI資本支出將持續」的假設之上，但這項假設尚未獲得實際營收驗證，相關法律協議的條件也相當嚴格。
報告認為，只要AI營收有「一季」未能達到支撐相關資本支出的程度，就可能動搖目前的投資邏輯。在這種情況下，部分企業董事會可能重新評估資本配置方向，而相關法律文件已經為這類決策預留空間。
此外，貝瑞也引用﻿宏碁(2353-TW) 執行長陳俊聖的說法。陳俊聖此前曾表示，隨著中國產能持續擴張，記憶體晶片產業的週期性可能重新出現。
陳俊聖表示，中國產能一直持續增加，因此很難認為市場會長期處於供應短缺狀態；目前合約價格則在高檔波動，部分價格上漲、部分價格下跌。

貝瑞持續看空AI，市場卻再創歷史新高

事實上，貝瑞今年已多次對股市與AI交易發出警告。
他今年5月曾表示，當時的股市表現讓他聯想到1999年至2000年網路泡沫的最後幾個月。本月稍早，他也進一步增加對美光、Nebius及安碩半導體ETF的空頭部位。
然而，市場走勢並未與其判斷同步。納斯達克綜合指數上週收在歷史新高。
部分AI相關個股則尚未回到歷史高點。美光目前仍較歷史高點低約16%，Palantir則低約10%。
除了AI相關部位調整外，貝瑞此次也建立一項與AI沒有直接關聯的新空頭部位，透過數年期LEAP看跌期權放空大都會人壽(MET-US) ，行使價約在70美元出頭。

items.title: 台灣大：配合審議時程延長30天 公開收購精誠期間至11月5日
items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile Extends Public Tender Period to November 5 to Align with Review Timeline
paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)今(29)日宣布，旗下子公司台信電訊公開收購精誠資訊(6214-TW)案，公平交易委員會已於9月16日正式受理事業結合申報，目前進入審查程序。為配合公平會法定30個工作日審議時程，並預留審議完成後的交割等作業時間，台信電訊已依法申報，並公告延長公開收購期間30個日曆天，由原訂10月6日下午3時30分，延長至11月5日下午3時30分。
台灣大表示，此次僅配合公平會審議時程延長公開收購期間，其餘公開收購條件均維持不變。每應賣1股精誠普通股，可換取現金92.5元以及台灣大普通股0.84股，最低收購數量為106,174,796股，約占精誠已發行股份39%，最高預定收購157,900,979股，約占58%。
台灣大指出，此案將持續依法令及公開收購程序辦理，並配合公平會審議推進後續作業，如有依法應公告事項，將依規定辦理公告。
paras_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045-TW) announced today (29) that its subsidiary Taiwan Telecom is publicly tendering for the acquisition of Jing Cheng Information (6214-TW). The Fair Trade Commission formally accepted the business combination filing on September 16 and is now in the review process. To comply with the Commission’s statutory 30‑working‑day review period and allow time for post‑review settlement, Taiwan Telecom has filed accordingly and announced an extension of the public tender period by 30 calendar days, moving the deadline from 3:30 pm on October 6 to 3:30 pm on November 5.

Taiwan Mobile said the extension is solely to match the Commission’s review schedule; all other tender conditions remain unchanged. For each share of Jing Cheng common stock sold, shareholders will receive NT$92.5 in cash and 0.84 shares of Taiwan Mobile common stock. The minimum acquisition is 106,174,796 shares, about 39% of Jing Cheng’s outstanding shares, and the maximum planned acquisition is 157,900,979 shares, about 58%.

Taiwan Mobile noted the transaction will continue to be carried out in accordance with applicable laws and public tender procedures, and will cooperate with the Commission’s review for subsequent steps. Any matters that must be disclosed by law will be announced as required.

items.title: 鴻海轉型有成 董座劉揚偉獲選2026全球百大製造業領袖第7名
items.title_en: Foxconn's Transformation Succeeds: Chairman Liu Yang-wei Ranked 7th in 2026 Global Top 100 Manufacturing Leaders
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)董事長劉揚偉再獲國際肯定，英國BizClik旗下製造業專業媒體《Manufacturing Digital》公布「2026 Top 100 Manufacturing Leaders」，劉揚偉名列全球第7名，顯示其帶領鴻海推動製造轉型、AI布局及全球化發展，獲國際製造業專業社群關注。
《Manufacturing Digital》指出，劉揚偉以「3+3+3」策略及BOL全球布局推動鴻海轉型，深化AI伺服器與智慧製造布局，並持續拓展AI、電動車、機器人、半導體及次世代通訊等領域，帶領鴻海從傳統製造服務進一步朝科技創新與全球智慧製造發展。
在AI布局之外，劉揚偉也將相關技術能力延伸至智慧醫療。鴻海投入3億元攜手臺北榮總打造智慧醫療示範場域，並逐步拓展至中榮、童綜合等醫療現場，將AI與科技創新導入醫療應用，提升醫護效率及病患照護。
《Manufacturing Digital》為英國BizClik旗下、聚焦全球製造業與智慧製造的國際B2B專業媒體，長期關注AI、工業數位轉型、供應鏈、永續及未來工廠等議題，讀者涵蓋全球製造業高階主管及產業決策者，在國際製造業專業社群具一定能見度。
除國際媒體肯定外，劉揚偉近期亦獲網路溫度計「2026第九屆網路口碑之星－年度最具網路好評影響力企業領袖」，以及台灣公關基金會「2026傑出公關獎－CEO形象獎」，肯定其企業領導形象及對外溝通表現。
劉揚偉重視企業與外界的溝通，持續透過公開場合、媒體交流及多元管道分享鴻海轉型方向與產業布局，讓股東、合作夥伴及社會大眾了解集團發展方向，並透過透明溝通累積外界對企業的理解。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) Chairman Liu Yang‑wei has received further international recognition. The UK‑based BizClik media outlet Manufacturing Digital released its “2026 Top 100 Manufacturing Leaders” list, placing Liu at global rank 7, highlighting his leadership in driving Foxconn’s manufacturing transformation, AI initiatives and global expansion, and drawing attention from the worldwide manufacturing community.

Manufacturing Digital noted that Liu is advancing Foxconn’s transformation with a “3+3+3” strategy and a BOL global footprint, deepening AI server and smart‑manufacturing capabilities while continuously expanding into AI, electric vehicles, robotics, semiconductors and next‑generation communications, steering the company from traditional contract manufacturing toward tech‑driven innovation and global smart‑manufacturing.

Beyond AI, Liu is extending related technological capabilities into smart healthcare. Foxconn has invested NT$300 million to partner with Taipei Veterans General Hospital to create a smart‑medical demonstration site, and is gradually expanding the initiative to other hospitals such as China Veterans General and Tung‑General, integrating AI and tech innovation into medical applications to boost care efficiency and patient outcomes.

Manufacturing Digital is an international B2B media brand under the UK’s BizClik group, focusing on global manufacturing and smart‑factory topics. It regularly covers AI, industrial digital transformation, supply‑chain, sustainability and future‑factory issues, reaching senior executives and decision‑makers worldwide and enjoying solid visibility within the professional manufacturing community.

In addition to the international media accolade, Liu recently earned the “2026 9th Online Reputation Star – Most Influential Leader with Positive Online Feedback” award from the Online Thermometer and the “2026 Outstanding PR Award – CEO Image Award” from Taiwan’s Public Relations Foundation, recognizing his corporate leadership image and external communication performance.

Liu places great importance on communication between the company and external stakeholders, continuously sharing Foxconn’s transformation direction and industry positioning through public appearances, media engagements and diverse channels, helping shareholders, partners and the public understand the group’s development path and building understanding through transparent dialogue.

items.title: 光寶科加入LOT Network 強化智慧財產權防護布局
items.title_en: Lite-On Technology Joins LOT Network to Strengthen Intellectual Property Protection Strategy
paras: 電源供應廠光寶科(2301-TW)今(29)日宣布，加入全球領先的專利授權平台及非營利社群 LOT Network，透過與超過 6,500 家會員企業共同合作，降低專利主張實體所帶來的訴訟風險，打造更具韌性的創新環境。
作為全球 AI 基礎設施、電源管理、光電、資訊科技、消費性電子及車用電子領域的領導廠商，光寶長期致力於推動創新與智慧財產權保護。在全球智慧財產權環境日益複雜的趨勢下，加入 LOT Network 反映光寶對於負責任專利管理（Responsible Patent Stewardship）的重視，並進一步強化對客戶、合作夥伴、供應商及整體產業生態系的保護。
光寶科技董事長宋明峰表示：「我們相信，企業有責任保護我們市場的利害關係人。加入 LOT Network，讓我們能將更多資源投入創新發展與產業合作，而非耗費於不必要的法律爭議。我們也樂見產業持續共同努力，降低 PAE 所帶來的風險，促進創新成果的發展與應用。」
Microsoft資深智慧財產授權總監Rob Kowal表示：「光寶是 Microsoft 重要的合作夥伴，我們也同為 LOT Network 會員。很高興看到光寶加入這項全球性的專利保護機制，光寶的加入將進一步強化企業社群共同降低 PAE 訴訟風險的力量。我們肯定光寶在這項議題上的積極投入，也期待光寶的加入能發揮示範作用，讓更多企業進一步了解 LOT Network 的價值。」
LOT Network 為目前全球最具規模的 PAE 風險防護機制之一。當會員企業持有的專利未來轉移至 PAE 時，其他會員將自動取得該專利授權，使其不再成為訴訟工具，從源頭降低專利訴訟風險。
LOT Network 執行長 Ken Seddon 表示：「許多企業並不知道，即使本身不擁有專利，也可能因日常營運使用的技術而面臨專利訴訟。光寶加入 LOT Network，不僅為客戶、合作夥伴及商業夥伴提供更多保護，也進一步提升整體產業生態系面對專利訴訟威脅的韌性。」
paras_en: Power supply manufacturer Lite-On Technology (2301-TW) announced today (the 29th) that it has joined LOT Network, a leading global patent‑licensing platform and nonprofit community, collaborating with more than 6,500 member companies to reduce the litigation risk posed by patent‑assertion entities and create a more resilient innovation environment.

As a global leader in AI infrastructure, power management, optoelectronics, information technology, consumer electronics and automotive electronics, Lite-On has long been committed to driving innovation and protecting intellectual property. In an increasingly complex global IP landscape, joining LOT Network reflects Lite-On’s emphasis on responsible patent stewardship and further strengthens protection for its customers, partners, suppliers and the broader industry ecosystem.

Lite-On Technology Chairman Song Ming‑Feng said, “We believe companies have a responsibility to protect the stakeholders in our market. Joining LOT Network allows us to allocate more resources to innovation and industry collaboration rather than spending them on unnecessary legal disputes. We also welcome the industry’s continued joint effort to reduce the risk posed by PAEs, fostering the development and application of innovative outcomes.”

Microsoft senior director of intellectual property licensing Rob Kowal said, “Lite-On is an important partner of Microsoft, and we are also members of LOT Network. We are pleased to see Lite-On join this global patent‑protection mechanism; its participation will further strengthen the collective ability of the corporate community to lower PAE litigation risk. We commend Lite-On’s proactive involvement on this issue and look forward to its joining serving as a model, helping more companies understand the value of LOT Network.”

LOT Network is currently one of the largest global mechanisms for mitigating PAE risk. When a patent owned by a member company is later transferred to a PAE, other members automatically receive a license to that patent, preventing it from being used as a litigation tool and reducing patent‑litigation risk at the source.

LOT Network CEO Ken Seddon said, “Many companies don’t realize that even if they don’t own patents themselves, they can still face patent lawsuits because of the technologies they use in daily operations. Lite-On’s entry into LOT Network not only provides greater protection for its customers, partners and business allies, but also further enhances the resilience of the overall industry ecosystem against patent‑litigation threats.”

items.title: 東元攜安達康參與新加坡Data Center World亮相MDC整合方案 攻東南亞AI基建商機
items.title_en: TECO Partners with Andakong to Showcase Integrated MDC Solutions at Singapore Data Center World, Targeting Southeast Asia AI Infrastructure Opportunities
paras: 東元(1504-TW)今(29)日指出，攜手子公司安達康科技參與新加坡Data Center World展會，展現資料中心電力系統與模組化(MDC)的一站式整合實力，並積極拓展東南亞AI基礎建設市場。
東元指出，此次展覽聚焦MDC的一站式建置能力，展出涵蓋IT、散熱、電力、發電機、EMS能源管理與控制系統的五大核心模組，並展現從需求分析、系統設計、工程規劃、設備製造、模組預製、系統整合、現場建置至測試交付的全流程服務能力。
東元以執行中的10MW模組化資料中心專案為例，呈現五大核心從整合設計、工廠預製到現場建置的實際應用。
東元指出，旗下MDC解決方案可依照客戶需求、建置條件及可靠度等級彈性配置，有效降低現場施工複雜度、縮短建置時程，並提升工程品質與能源使用效率，滿足CSP對快速部署及彈性擴充的需求。
另外，東元整合集團設備製造與系統整合資源，由旗下安達康(TECOBAR)展出裝甲式及模鑄式匯流排產品，透過高載流能力、模組化設計及快速部署等優勢，因應AI資料中心不同規模與配置需求。
東元進一步指出，為提升在地供應與快速交付效率，安達康今年在馬來西亞檳城啟用裝甲式匯流排新廠，規劃年產能達40萬米，產品也以此通過IEC與UL國際認證。
總經理高飛鳶表示，全球AI算力需求持續升溫，資料中心的建置速度與供電穩定性成為企業競爭關鍵。而東元深耕資料中心基礎建設，已累計承攬建置容量1GW，並整合機電、電力、工程與模組預製能力，協助國際客戶加速AI資料中心部署。
未來東元將以馬來西亞為東南亞資料中心工程及模組預製的重要基地，持續拓展新加坡、泰國、印尼、菲律賓等高成長市場。
paras_en: TECO (1504‑TW) said today (the 29th) that together with its subsidiary Andakong Technology it is taking part in Singapore’s Data Center World exhibition, demonstrating its one‑stop integration capabilities for data‑center power systems and modular data centers (MDC) while actively expanding into the Southeast Asian AI infrastructure market.

TECO noted that the exhibition focuses on the one‑stop build capability of MDC, displaying five core modules covering IT, cooling, power, generators, and EMS energy‑management and control systems, and showcasing its full‑process service from demand analysis, system design, engineering planning, equipment manufacturing, module prefabrication, system integration, on‑site construction to testing and hand‑over.

Using an ongoing 10 MW modular data‑center project as an example, TECO presented the practical application of the five core modules from integrated design and factory prefabrication to on‑site construction.

TECO said its MDC solution can be flexibly configured according to customer needs, build conditions and reliability levels, effectively reducing on‑site construction complexity, shortening build time, and improving project quality and energy‑use efficiency, meeting CSPs’ requirements for rapid deployment and flexible scaling.

In addition, TECO integrated its group’s equipment manufacturing and system‑integration resources, with its subsidiary Andakong (TECOBAR) exhibiting armored and molded‑busbar products that, thanks to high current‑carrying capacity, modular design and fast deployment, address the varied scale and configuration needs of AI data centers.

TECO further explained that to boost local supply and fast delivery, Andakong launched a new armored‑busbar plant in Penang, Malaysia this year, planning an annual capacity of 400,000 m and having obtained IEC and UL international certifications for its products.

General Manager Gao Feiyuan said global AI compute demand continues to rise, making data‑center build speed and power‑supply stability key competitive factors for enterprises. TECO, deeply rooted in data‑center infrastructure, has so far undertaken 1 GW of build capacity and integrates electromechanical, power, engineering and module‑prefabrication capabilities to help international customers accelerate AI data‑center deployments.

Looking ahead, TECO will use Malaysia as a key hub for Southeast Asian data‑center projects and module prefabrication, and will continue to expand into high‑growth markets such as Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia and the Philippines.

items.title: 「小台積」0052見證台灣科技黃金20年 報酬翻24倍、規模逾1600億元
items.title_en: "Little TSMC" 0052 Witnesses Taiwan's 20-Year Tech Golden Age, Returns Up 24‑Fold, Assets Over NT$1.6 trillion
paras: 臺灣首檔科技主題 ETF 富邦科技(0052-TW)迎來掛牌20周年，累積投資報酬率超過2,400%，隨著商品分割降門檻，資產規模一舉突破1,600億元。投資人關注 0052 股價已大漲24倍，未來能否續投？富邦投信指出，此波成長並非單純資金吹捧，而是由AI強勁的硬體需求與訂單能見度(上看至2028年)所支撐；加上台灣掌握全球逾七成先進製程，0052 完整涵蓋全台科技產業鏈，在供不應求的科技創新浪潮下，仍具備長線轉型與持續參與的投資價值。

證交所林修銘：台灣ETF市場亮眼 扮演亞太重要樞紐

證交所董事長林修銘於致詞時指出，富邦科技ETF於2006年上市，當時正值臺灣產業由傳統產業轉型至高科技發展的關鍵階段。作為台灣第一檔科技主題ETF，0052不僅掌握了轉型契機，也為投資人提供參與科技成長的管道。
林修銘表示，台灣ETF市場規模成長驚人，從2003年第一檔ETF問世，截至2026年8月底，市場已擁有350檔ETF，上市櫃總資產規模突破11兆元，日均成交值達864.2億元。過去十年間，全球ETF資產規模成長5.66倍，而台灣ETF規模則成長了34倍，躍升為亞太地區第三大ETF市場。證交所未來將持續扮演溝通橋樑，推動商品多元化並協助業者邁向國際，期望將0052等成功經驗推廣至全球市場。

報酬率翻24倍！「小台積」0052完整涵蓋台灣科技供應鏈

富邦投信董事長黃昭棠表示，0052對於台灣證券市場與富邦投信均具有極具代表性的特殊意義，它既是全台第一檔科技型ETF，也是富邦投信發行的首檔ETF旗艦產品。自2006年掛牌至今，0052陪伴投資人走過PC、智慧型手機、3G/4G/5G到電動車與AI等技術革新。
黃昭棠提到，2006年發行初期，台積電在0052中的權重約為20%，截至2026年8月底，台積電持有權重已達64%，因此市場常形象地稱其為「小台積」。0052追蹤的「臺灣科技電子指數」嚴選臺灣50與中型100指數中的72檔科技電子股，完整涵蓋整體科技供應鏈。自掛牌以來，0052累積投資報酬率超過2,400%，展現長線豐厚的資本利得成果。

分割降低門檻效益顯著 AI基礎建設推升未來成長動能

富邦科技(0052-TW)基金經理人洪珮甄進一步分享，去(2025)年0052進行股票分割後，投資門檻大幅降低，帶動資產規模從約245億元迅速攀升至目前超過1,600億元，成長超過5倍；受益人數亦快速突破45萬至將近50萬人，定期定額戶數超過7萬戶，近一年規模與人數均成長逾10倍，名列市場前茅。
展望未來，洪珮甄分析，全球AI需求已進入大規模推論與實質應用階段，主要的雲端服務提供業者(CSP)資本支出持續擴張，訂單能見度甚至已延伸至2028年。而台灣在先進製程掌握超過七成產能，且在IC設計、先進封裝、散熱與PCB等硬體鏈皆具備獨步全球的實力。0052不僅投資單一巨頭，更是布局全台灣科技產業鏈的極佳工具，未來將持續扮演全民參與科技成長脈動的最佳夥伴。
paras_en: Taiwan's first technology‑themed ETF, Fubon Technology (0052‑TW), celebrates its 20th anniversary on the exchange, having delivered a cumulative return of over 2,400%. After a stock split lowered the entry barrier, its asset base surged past NT$1.6 trillion. Investors note that the price of 0052 has risen 24‑times and wonder whether the rally can continue. Fubon Asset Management says the growth is not merely a money‑fuelled hype but is backed by strong AI‑related hardware demand and order visibility out to 2028. With Taiwan controlling more than 70% of the world’s advanced‑process capacity, 0052 fully covers the island’s tech supply chain, giving it long‑term transformation value amid a wave of scarce‑supply tech innovation.

Taiwan Stock Exchange Chairman Lin Hsiu‑Ming highlighted the brilliance of Taiwan’s ETF market, calling it a key hub in the Asia‑Pacific. He noted that the Fubon Technology ETF launched in 2006, coinciding with Taiwan’s shift from traditional industries to high‑tech development. As the island’s first tech‑themed ETF, 0052 captured that transition opportunity and gave investors a channel to participate in tech growth.

Lin said Taiwan’s ETF market has grown dramatically, from the first ETF in 2003 to 350 ETFs by the end of August 2026, with total listed‑company assets exceeding NT$11 trillion and daily turnover reaching NT$864.2 billion. Over the past decade, global ETF assets grew 5.66‑fold, while Taiwan’s ETF assets expanded 34‑fold, making it the third‑largest ETF market in the region. The exchange will keep acting as a bridge, promoting product diversification and helping issuers go global, hoping to replicate the success of 0052 worldwide.

The fund’s return has multiplied 24‑times! "Little TSMC" 0052 fully covers Taiwan’s tech supply chain. Fubon Asset Management Chairman Huang Chao‑Tang said 0052 holds special significance for both the Taiwanese market and the firm—it is the island’s first tech‑focused ETF and Fubon’s flagship ETF product. Since its 2006 debut, 0052 has ridden the waves of PC, smartphones, 3G/4G/5G, electric vehicles and AI innovations.

Huang noted that when the fund launched in 2006, TSMC accounted for about 20% of 0052’s holdings; by the end of August 2026, TSMC’s weight had risen to 64%, leading the market to nickname the ETF “Little TSMC.” 0052 tracks the Taiwan Technology Electronics Index, which selects 72 tech‑electronics stocks from the Taiwan 50 and Mid‑Cap 100 indices, covering the entire tech supply chain. Since listing, 0052 has delivered a cumulative return of over 2,400%, demonstrating strong long‑term capital gains.

Fund manager Hong Pei‑Jen of Fubon Technology (0052‑TW) added that after the 2025 stock split, the investment threshold fell sharply, propelling assets from about NT$245 billion to over NT$1.6 trillion—a more‑than‑5‑fold increase. Beneficiary numbers quickly rose from 450,000 to nearly 500,000, with regular‑savings accounts exceeding 70,000. In the past year, both assets and participants grew over ten‑fold, placing the fund among the market leaders.

Looking ahead, Hong analyses that global AI demand has entered a large‑scale inference and real‑world application phase, with cloud service providers expanding capex and order visibility extending to 2028. Taiwan controls over 70% of advanced‑process capacity and boasts world‑leading strengths in IC design, advanced packaging, thermal solutions and PCBs. 0052 not only invests in a single giant but also offers a comprehensive tool to capture the whole Taiwanese tech industry chain, positioning it as the best partner for broad public participation in tech growth.

paras_en: During the Mid‑Autumn holiday, U.S. stocks swung wildly. Taiwan’s market opened after the break and briefly turned positive, but trading volume froze unusually. Under the double squeeze of lingering margin financing and weak turnover, the divergence between volume and price has locked bulls and bears in a stalemate. Yet, as the market’s volume shrinks, smart money is quietly shifting toward the next wave of industries benefiting from upgrades and earnings‑call themes.
Post‑holiday volume contraction oscillation, the real key is the freeze of buying at higher prices

Affected by heightened U.S. market volatility during the Mid‑Autumn break, Taiwan’s market opened shaky today. The weighted index briefly turned positive intraday but closed down 392.64 points at 47,631.96, slipping below the 48,000 mark. Trading volume was only about NT$785 billion. The index decline isn’t the most noteworthy point; the real focus is volume. Sell pressure didn’t expand noticeably and was even lower than pre‑holiday levels, but buying interest at higher prices froze to a one‑month low. This indicates it’s not a full‑scale bear attack; both sides are pulling back. Especially since margin balances rose sharply before the holiday, the lack of accompanying momentum creates pressure on floating gains and trapped positions. As analyst Zhi‑Lin Chen says, while volume‑price divergence and unsettled capital persist, there’s no need to chase price aggressively—adopt a “watch more, act less” stance, keep cash and position flexibility.
No volume on the market doesn’t mean no opportunity; a contrarian strength highlights industry logic

The market’s momentum may be limited, but that doesn’t mean every stock lacks chance. The real focus remains industry trends. Demand for high‑end power supplies and high‑speed connections keeps heating up, driving Maolian‑KY (3665‑TW) to rally against the tide today, up NT$105 or 4.49%. When Maolian‑KY’s low‑volume consolidation earlier this week was spotted, analyst Chen had already positioned members. The price briefly retested the yearly moving average, but he didn’t change his view because of the wobble. He argues that a stock’s daily color isn’t decisive; the underlying logic of high‑end power, AI data centers, and high‑speed transmission remains unchanged. Short‑term moves may swing, but the true determinant of a wave’s longevity is industry structure. Maolian‑KY’s renewed volume‑driven strength gave patient builders tangible wave gains today.

Conversely, Jingyuan Electronics (2449‑TW) showed a clear pull‑back after a rapid prior surge. We had already led members to take profits at relatively high levels. Even the best industry can’t ignore price levels and capital inertia; buying high, selling low is simple in theory, but execution makes all the difference.

paras: 在 2026 年 7 月及8月營收連續度突破百億元大關創新高的 PCB 廠金像電 (2368-TW)， 今 (29) 日公布以每股856元發行私募現增股約1586張，募集約15.89億元，最受人矚目的是客戶端的亞馬遜(AMZN-US.)參與此次私募案，這也是亞馬遜首度持有金像電股權，象徵雙方合作關係更爲密切。

The key participant is Amazon.com, Inc., which is acquiring equity in the PCB maker for the first time and is estimated to hold about 0.3% of Golden Image’s shares after the transaction.
